tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje phur pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus thams cad la// sgo gsum kun nas rab tu dang ba yis// rab tu gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal la/ོ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i phyir// dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs dam tshig ldan pa yis// dur khrod la sogs yid dang mthun gnas su// stan la bder 'dug skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya// bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi// snying ga'i hūm̐ las tshogs zhing spyan drangs la// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ lus dpag med pas phyag bya zhing*// sngags sngon 'gro ba'i mchod yon sogs// gsang sngags phyag rgya dang bcas mchod// ye shes sku mchog sogs brjod cing*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can// bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa kun gyis mchod bgyid cing*// bdag gi lus kyang dbul bar bya// bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du gang dag stsal ba dang*// rjes su bdag ni yi rang bas// bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas ni// sgo gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams// khyed la ma lus so sor bshags// sangs rgyas byang chub sems tshogs dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom dang*// so so skye bo'i dge ba la// yang dag rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor sngags bdag he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can// de rnams la yang skyabs su mchi// dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi// byang chub sems kyi dpa' bo mchog /khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems can srid mtshor lhung gyur pa// de rnams kun la phan pa'i phyir// bdag gi dus 'di nyid du ni// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub spyod pa spyad byas nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/ces pa bcu po rnam dag dang*// bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa rnams// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje'i rigs mchog sdom pa ni// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa ni// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po ni// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog sdom pa ni// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub nas kyang*// sems can 'khor bar bying ba rnams// byang chub gnas su bsgral bar bgyi// ces pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa ni// lan gsum bar du brjod de gzung*// tshad med bzhi ni bsgoms nas kyang*// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong par bsgoms pas tshogs gnyis so// snang ba stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// ram̐ las nyi steng hūm̐ nag las// 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// rwa ba drwa ba bla re gur// bskal pa'i me 'bar nang du ni// bh+rum̐ las ma lus bgegs 'joms pa'i// srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu rno// rab 'bar myur du 'khor ba yi// dbus dang rtsibs su pad nyi'i steng*// dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan// tshangs sogs phyogs kyi bdag po rnams// bsam bya rak+ṣa'i sngags rab brjod// kī la ya yi sngags brjod pas// dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog sngo// zhal gcig khro gnyer spyan gsum 'bar// g.yas pas phur pa bgegs la bsnun// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub phyag gnyis po// sbrul dang mi sdug gis brgyan cing*// sku smad phur bu me 'bar dbal// bgegs kyi spyi bor gdab bsam bya// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan rnams// song shig lha min gang yang rung*// nga la bar chad rtsom pa'i bdud/

mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gzhom par bya// brjod de gtso ba'i thugs ka nas// rang rang sngags rnams brjod bzhin du// steng du khro bo'i rgyal po ni// rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa// steng gi phyogs sogs bgegs 'joms sogs// sprul dang yang sprul dpag yas rnams// me dpung rab 'bar bzhin du 'phros// bgegs sogs gnod byed ma lus pa// rengs rmugs gnan dang gzir ba dang*// bskrad cing bsad pa'i las mdzod cig /khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyi// lus ni rdul du brlag par gyis// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// zhes brjod de ltar bsam pa'o// de ni mtshams bcad rim pa yin// gong du bstan pa'i sngags brjod pas// chos rnams skye med stong par bsam// dharma dhā tu āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ chos dbyings rang bzhin 'khor 'das kyi// byed po rang sems 'od gsal yin// yi ge a yi rang bzhin no// rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod// nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le 'char// srog gi go ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus// snod bcud thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus// s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ slar yang bsdus par bsam par bya// yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ las// rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// keng rus ri rab gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi// rtsig pa dkar ser dmar ljang nag /rin chen phag ser drwa phyed dang*// mda' yab pu shu kra ma sha// 'dod yon snam bu dmar po la// lha mo bcu drug mchod byed cing*// rdo rje'i gdung bzhi rdo rje'i rwa// ka brgyad kyis bteg mig mangs ris// dbus rtse byur bur rdo rje'i tog /rta babs steng du chos 'khor ro// ri dwags g.yang gzhi'i gdugs phub cing*// zhing chen rgyal mtshan mi mgo'i tog /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi// phyi rol dur khrod brgyad rnams so// nang gi lha snam phyogs mdog go

/bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dha dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser// mgo skam mu khyud keng rus phub// g.yang gzhi bla re rgyu rlon gyi// lda ldis rab brgyan lte ba la// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'o// e ram̐ zhes ni brjod par bya// pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya/ a tsan+d+ra/ pad nyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ma hā de ba u ma de bī sti ra bam̐/ sngar bshad gdan dang sgo bzhi ru// pad nyi yi dwags gdan rnams so// hūm̐ badz+ra/ dbus su rang sems rdo rjer gyur// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyings sgra 'od 'phros don gnyis byas// slar 'dus dbus su bdag nyid ni /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// mthing nag gzhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag /spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra ser 'khyil// mi mgo skam lngas dbu brgyan cing*// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can// phyag g.yas dang po rtse dgu dang*// bar bas rdo rje rtse lnga pa// thod khrag me 'bar g.yon dang pos// bar pas tri shūl 'bar ba ste// mtha' gnyis phur 'dril dgra bgegs kyi// snying gi dkyil du 'debs pa'o// sbrul rgyan stag sham thal chen dang*// khrag zhag thig le rus rgyan sogs// khro bo'i rgyan cha bco brgyad 'chang*// sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod dang drag shul rab 'jigs pa// snying rje rngam zhing gar dgu'i nyams// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs// yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dril bu// g.yon pas yab 'khyud thod khrag bsnams// gzig gi sham thabs rus rgyan lnga// yab yum gnyis med 'khril bar ni// ye shes me dpung klong dkyil bzhugs// rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang ba'o// yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ yig dang*// yum gyi mkha' la a las ni// rdo rje pad+ma'i sa bon can// snyoms 'jug zag med bde chen pos// yab yum 'od phung thig ler gyur// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// 'khor ba rdo rje grub par mdzod// 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi rten du bdag bskyed cig

/ces bskul thig le rdo rje dang*// dril bur gyur te bdag nyid ni// 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'o// de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis// thabs kyi spyod pa sems can rnams// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces bskul mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 ham̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhī dī pa ya ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sū ka ra mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra i ṣu pa mu khi hūm̐/ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ mdzad sngo// zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa 'khor lo mda' gzhu'o// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo sgra 'byin ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// phag dang rmig pa'i mgo can gnyis// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi la si ki hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra byā gh+ra mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gṛ ḍh+ra mu khi hūm̐/ shar du khro bo rnam rgyal dkar// zhal gsum g.yas sngo g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa 'khor lo tri shūl 'dzin// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo mda' snyems ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur pa 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pa'i stabs// brgya byin gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// stag dang bya rgod mgo can gnyis// sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar bya// oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/

da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi tī tā ru hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tsā ma ra mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tā na mu khi hūm̐/ shar lhor khro rgyal dbyug sngon sngo// zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa dbyug pa me 'bar 'dzin// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo sder mo ni// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i stabs// me lha'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// g.yag dang bya rog mgo can gnyis// sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhish+ma shā na pa ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ha ri ṇa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u lū ka mu khi hūm̐/ lho phyogs gshin rje gshed mthing nag /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa dgra s+t+wa dbyug pa 'dzin// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo dur khrod bdag /sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// gshin rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// sha ba 'ug pa'i gdong can gnyis// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur pa 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi mu ha la hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra d+ya ki mu kha hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra pre ta mu khi hūm̐/ lho nub khro rgyal mi g.yo gnag /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa ral gri zhags pa'o// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo gtun khung ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// srin po'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// gzig dang khwa da'i mgo can gnyis// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi dza ya ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi ṭā la mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pak+ṣi ta mu khi hūm̐/ nub phyogs khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar// zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa sngo// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa ral gri sbrul zhags so// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo gtum pa mo// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// chu lha'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// byi la pu shud mgo can gnyis// sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol par byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi sa bya ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sṛ ga la mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra ṇa mu khi hūm̐/ nub byang gzhan gyis mi thub dmar// zhal gsum g.yas sngo g.yon pa ljang*// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa lcags kyu rnga yab bo// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo mda' snyems ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// rlung lha'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// spyang ki khra yi mgo can gnyis// sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/

ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi sa bya mi ti hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sidha mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ti ti la mu khi hūm̐/ byang phyogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ljang skya// zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// sna tshogs rdo rje be con bar// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo sgra mdzad ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i nyams// gnod spyin gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// seng ge pha wang mgo can gnyis// sku mdog ljang skya zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bhin+da bhin+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi mā ra ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nā ku la mu khi hūm̐/ byang shar 'jig rten gsum rgyal dkar// zhal gsum g.yas sngo g.yon pa ljang*// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pa rdo rje tri shū la// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo gsod byed ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i stabs// bi nā ya ka'i gdan la bzhugs// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// dred dang sre mo'i mgo can gnyis// sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhi muṇ+ḍe mam̐ hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ka shi ka mu khi hūm̐/ 'og phyogs stobs chen dud kha'i mdog /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar// phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis// rdo rje dang ni thod khrag 'dzin// bar pas tho ba gtun shing ngo*// 'og gnyis phur 'dril yum la 'khyud// de dang gnyis su med pa'i yum// rdo rje lha mo rig byed ma// sku mdog yab mtshungs zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stobs// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i zhabs// sa bdag gdan la bzhugs pa'o// khro chen sprul pa'i phra men ma// dom dang byi ba'i mgo can gnyis// sku mdog dud ka zhal gcig ma// phyag gnyis g.yas pas phur bu 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag gsol bar byed// oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sa da hūm̐ dzaḥ shar sgor pu shud mgo can dkar// g.yas pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badz+ra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ lho sgor bya rog mgo can ser// g.yas pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o// oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can dmar// g.yas pas lcags sgrog 'dzin
